desert = a very dry area with little rain
island = a piece of land with water all around it
valley = low land between hills or mountains
waterfall = a place where a river falls from a high point
volcano = a mountain that can send out hot rock and ash
earthquake = a sudden, strong shaking of the ground
protect = to keep someone or something safe from harm
global warming = the slow rise in the Earth's temperature
greenhouse effect = gases in the air that trap heat from the sun
renewable energy = power from the sun, wind or water that will not run out
species = a group of animals or plants of the same kind
wild animal = an animal that does not live with people as a pet
insect = a small animal with six legs, such as a bee or ant
plant = a living thing that grows in soil, such as a tree or flower
harvest = the time when crops are collected; to collect them
season = one of the four parts of the year with typical weather
sunny = with a lot of sun and few clouds
rainy = with a lot of rain
windy = with a strong wind
snowy = with snow falling or on the ground
